accounts.name: instructionsSysvar
docs: program can locate the sibling Ed25519Program instruction proving the
delegator signature.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pause the verifier. Halts `verify_and_execute`, `register_agent`, and
`update_policy`. Closes the dead `paused` field in `VerifierConfig`.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Resume the verifier.

instructions.name: commitAuditRoot
docs: WS-6 — Anchor a Merkle root of the worker's sealed audit log on-chain.
The instruction performs structural validation and persists the
(root, sequence_high, anchored_at, signature) tuple in a per-agent
`AuditAnchor` PDA, plus emits `AuditRootCommitted`.
**Signature verification model.** The ed25519 signature over
`(agent_pubkey, root, sequence_high, anchored_at)` is verified
off-chain by indexers using the agent's registered pubkey. The
payload format is fixed by `tee-worker/src/main.rs::build_anchor_signing_payload`,
so a third-party auditor that re-derives the payload + checks the
signature against `registry.agent_pubkey` has the same guarantees as
an on-chain verifier. Adding the on-chain ed25519 precompile to this
instruction is left as a follow-up (it requires reading the
instructions sysvar to confirm a sibling `Ed25519Program` ix ran);
the data path is fully wired today.
We DO refuse trivially-bad inputs:
- sequence_high must monotonically increase,
- root must not be all-zeros (genesis is meaningless to anchor),
- anchored_at must be within ±5 minutes of the on-chain Clock.

accounts.name: agentPubkey
docs: as the ed25519 verifying key. Anchor validates the seed; the program
verifies the signature.

accounts.name: verifierVk
docs: On-chain Groth16 VK. Loaded read-only every verify; rotated via the
multisig + timelock instructions below. Closes F-9.

accounts.name: nonceAccount
docs: Nonce PDA. We use `init_if_needed` so an existing PDA does NOT silently
fail account-validation; instead we explicitly check `consumed_at == 0`
in the instruction body and surface `NonceAlreadyConsumed` (closes
F-27). Including `registry.agent_pubkey` in the seed prevents
cross-agent nonce confusion (see MIGRATION.md).

instructions.name: initializeVerifierVk
docs: Initialize the empty `VerifierVk` PDA. Subsequent `seed_vk` or
`execute_vk_update` populates the bytes.

instructions.name: seedVk
docs: Bootstrap the VK from `GLYPH_VK_REAL` if it was baked in via the
`real-vk` build feature. Returns `RealVkUnavailable` otherwise.

accounts.name: VerifierVk
docs: On-chain Groth16 verification key, stored in a singleton PDA at seeds
`[b"verifier_vk"]`.
The verifier loads the VK from this account at every `verify_and_execute`
call. Updates are gated by `VkMultisig` + a 24-hour timelock.

fields.name: betaG2

fields.name: gammaG2

fields.name: deltaG2

fields.name: ic

fields.name: controlRoot

fields.name: bn254ControlId

fields.name: vkHash

delta || ic[0..6] || control_root || bn254_control_id). Convenience
for off-chain integrity checks.

fields.name: imageId
docs: RISC Zero circuit image_id this VK was extracted for.

fields.name: proverVersion
docs: Free-form prover-version string (e.g. `"risc0-zkvm 1.2.6"`). Bounded
to 64 bytes via the size constant below.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

accounts.name: VkMultisig
docs: Multisig governance account for VK rotations. Singleton at seeds
`[b"vk_multisig"]`.

fields.name: signers
docs: Authorized signers (zero-padded; only the first `signer_count` entries
are live).

fields.name: signerCount
docs: Number of live signer entries (≤ `VK_MULTISIG_MAX_SIGNERS`).

fields.name: threshold
docs: Number of approvals required to execute a pending update.

fields.name: pendingUpdate
docs: Optional in-flight proposal.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

accounts.name: AgentRegistry
docs: Agent registry account - tracks registered AI agents

fields.name: imageId
docs: Pinned RISC Zero circuit image_id. Proofs whose committed image_id does
not match are rejected. Closes F-8.

accounts.name: AuditAnchor
docs: WS-6: Per-agent audit-root anchor (closes T20 part 2).
The TEE worker periodically Merkle-roots its sealed audit log and submits
`commit_audit_root(root, sequence_high)`. The instruction verifies an
ed25519 signature over `(agent_pubkey, root, sequence_high, anchored_at)`
against the agent's registered pubkey (the worker IS the agent's signer
per the audit's WS-6 §2 wiring) and persists the result here. Off-chain
auditors compare exported audit-log Merkle roots against this anchor.

accounts.name: NonceAccount
docs: Nonce account - tracks consumed nonces for replay prevention

accounts.name: VerifierConfig
docs: Verifier config account - protocol-level configuration

accounts.name: RelayAccount
docs: Relay account state for cross-chain bridges

types.name: VerifierVkInner
docs: Inner VK payload used by the `propose_vk_update` instruction. Mirrors
`Groth16VerifyingKey` but is `AnchorSerialize`/`AnchorDeserialize` so it
can travel over the wire as instruction args.

types.name: PendingVkUpdate
docs: A pending VK rotation. Cleared on `execute_vk_update` (success) or
`cancel_vk_update` (out of scope here — operators redeploy multisig if a
proposal must be aborted before timelock).

fields.name: newVkHash
docs: SHA-256 of the proposed VK bytes (used to bind approvals to a specific
candidate; signers approve a hash, not the live `pending_update.vk`).

fields.name: newImageId
docs: Image_id to install with the new VK.

fields.name: proposedAt
docs: Unix timestamp at which the proposal was made.

fields.name: approvedSigners
docs: Multisig signers that have approved this hash. The proposer is
implicitly the first approver.

fields.name: vk
docs: Full proposed VK bytes — kept inline so `execute_vk_update` does not
need to re-receive them and risk a TOCTOU between approval and exec.

types.name: Groth16Proof
docs: Groth16 proof structure for BN254 proofs.
A Groth16 proof consists of three elliptic curve points:
- A: G1 point (64 bytes: 32 bytes x || 32 bytes y)
- B: G2 point (128 bytes: two G1 coordinates)
- C: G1 point (64 bytes: 32 bytes x || 32 bytes y)

fields.name: imageId
docs: Circuit image_id this agent's proofs must commit to. Closes F-8.

fields.name: delegatorSignature
docs: WS-9: Ed25519 signature by the delegator (the human/principal granting
the agent its powers) over the canonical delegation payload. Verified
against a sibling `Ed25519Program` instruction. See
`delegation_signing_payload` for the byte layout.

fields.name: delegatorPubkey
docs: WS-9: Public key of the delegator. Must match the
`Ed25519Program` instruction's pubkey + payload.

fields.name: delegationExpiry
docs: WS-9: Expiry timestamp (unix seconds) of the delegation itself. The
agent may not register past this point. Included in the signed payload.

types.name: CommitAuditRootArgs
docs: WS-6 — `commit_audit_root` instruction arguments.
Worker submits the Merkle root + the highest sequence number it has
anchored, plus an ed25519 signature over the canonical payload (see
`tee-worker/src/main.rs::build_anchor_signing_payload`).

fields.name: workerSignature
docs: Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload, by the agent_pubkey.
